points.description: States that a prototype program simulates/imitates/mimics (or gives a working model or preview of) the behaviour of parts of the intended software product.
points.partial_credit: Award about 2-3 marks for a related but incomplete statement, e.g. it is a test or trial version, a sample or early version of the software, or helps check ideas, without saying it mimics the behaviour of the final product or its parts.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying in any wording that a prototype simulates, models or imitates how parts of the final software will behave. Give part marks for vague or incomplete answers, such as a trial, sample or early version, or a way to test ideas, that don't say it mimics the product's behaviour. Give no marks for answers about something unrelated. Extra correct detail does no harm.
